description: This file contains implementation of command-line interface commands for logging control in Zephyr OS, including backend management, log level settings, status reporting, and memory usage.

methods.name: backend_find
methods.description: Finds a log backend instance by name.

methods.name: shell_state_precheck
methods.description: Checks if the shell log backend is initialized.

methods.name: shell_backend_cmd_execute
methods.description: Executes a command on a specified log backend.

methods.name: log_status
methods.description: Displays the status of log modules and their levels.

methods.name: cmd_log_self_status
methods.description: Handles 'log status' command for the current shell backend.

methods.name: cmd_log_backend_status
methods.description: Handles 'log backend status' command.

methods.name: module_id_get
methods.description: Retrieves module ID by name.

methods.name: filters_set
methods.description: Sets log level filters for modules.

methods.name: severity_level_get
methods.description: Converts severity level string to index.

methods.name: log_enable
methods.description: Enables logging at a specified severity level for modules.

methods.name: cmd_log_self_enable
methods.description: Handles 'log enable' command for current backend.

methods.name: cmd_log_backend_enable
methods.description: Handles 'log enable' command for specified backend.

methods.name: log_disable
methods.description: Disables logging for modules.

methods.name: cmd_log_self_disable
methods.description: Handles 'log disable' command for current backend.

methods.name: cmd_log_backend_disable
methods.description: Handles 'log disable' command for specified backend.

methods.name: module_name_get
methods.description: Retrieves module name for dynamic command.

methods.name: severity_lvl_get
methods.description: Retrieves severity level string for dynamic command.

methods.name: log_halt
methods.description: Halts logging on a backend.

methods.name: cmd_log_self_halt
methods.description: Handles 'log halt' command for current backend.

methods.name: cmd_log_backend_halt
methods.description: Handles 'log halt' command for specified backend.

methods.name: log_go
methods.description: Activates logging on a backend.

methods.name: cmd_log_self_go
methods.description: Handles 'log go' command for current backend.

methods.name: cmd_log_backend_go
methods.description: Handles 'log go' command for specified backend.

methods.name: cmd_log_backends_list
methods.description: Lists all available log backends.

methods.name: cmd_log_mem
methods.description: Displays memory usage of log buffers.
